name: Storybook & Shadcn-ui
summary: Component stories for shadcn/ui documented in a Next.js Storybook, hosted on Chromatic behind a login.
description: A Next.js project that documents shadcn/ui components as Storybook stories, with light and dark themes for the Storybook UI and preview, global and per-story decorators, MDX documentation pages and Jest story tests. The Chromatic deployment is not publicly accessible; the project's source repository is public.
contains: Storybook stories for shadcn/ui components in a Next.js app
light and dark theme for Storybook UI and component preview
MDX introduction and component docs pages
story tests with Jest and accessibility coverage
Chromatic deployment requires login; 69 GitHub stars
